relationships.evidence_quote: The MRGPRX2 pathway is functionally upregulated in the colon of patients with IBS, supporting its role in abdominal pain in IBS.

key_findings: MRGPRX2 agonists trigger mast cell degranulation and TRPV1 sensitisation in healthy human colon submucosa.
Submucosal mast cells from IBS patients show increased MRGPRX2-agonist-induced degranulation, and biopsy supernatants have higher MRGPRX2 agonistic activity with increased substance P.
